title: Government Schemes Masterfile (10-Bucket Complete Framework)
summary: The ultimate 10-Bucket Government Schemes Masterfile for SBI PO, RBI Grade B, and IBPS PO. Includes Master Classification Framework, Central Sector vs Centrally Sponsored, Ministry Quick-Maps, Umbrella Schemes, Funding Ratios, and Master Trap Tables.

blocks.title: Government Schemes Master Classification Rule
blocks.summary: Central Sector Schemes are 100% funded and directly implemented by the Central Government. Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS) are funded jointly (60:40 or 90:10 for NE/Hills) and implemented by State Governments.

blocks.content:
Think of the Indian government like a **hospital with many departments**:
- **Central Government:** Hospital management — sets policy, funds big programs, monitors outcomes.
- **State Governments:** Ward doctors — implement on the ground.
- **Schemes:** Treatment plans — each designed for a specific problem.

items: **Ministry of Finance / DFS:** PMJDY, PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY, MUDRA, Stand Up India, SGB, GMS, SCSS, Jan Samarth Portal, NIP.
**Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare:** PM-KISAN, PMFBY, PMKSY (More Crop Per Drop), eNAM, PKVY, Soil Health Card, RKVY-RAFTAAR, KCC.
**Ministry of Rural Development:** MGNREGS, PMAY-Gramin, PMGSY, DAY-NRLM (Lakhpati Didi, SVEP), PMGDISHA.
**Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs:** PMAY-Urban, ARHC, Smart Cities Mission, AMRUT 2.0, Swachh Bharat Urban 2.0, HRIDAY, DAY-NULM, PM SVANidhi.
**Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY):** Digital India, DigiLocker, UMANG, CSC, IndiaStack, ONDC, IndiaAI Mission, Semicon India.
